The latest Quinnipiac University showed Trump's approval rating at 32%, while 58% of respondents said they disapproved of the president's job performance. According to the pollster, Trump’s performance in the poll is the worst recorded in either of his terms in the White House. Nearly half the voters surveyed also said they are "worse off financially" then they were one year ago and 88% said they feel inflation is a very serious or somewhat serious problem. [...] CBS News

results.content:
The survey found that just 45% of Utah voters approve of Trump’s job performance as president compared to 52% who disapprove. Among those who disapprove of his job performance, 11% say they somewhat disapprove and 41% strongly disapprove.
